card.name: Backup contraception advice wording
card.fires_on: The last word of advice to use extra or alternative birth control, such as "contraception", "used" or "methods", in drug-interaction and pregnancy-prevention passages. The pole also fires on a few similar closing words such as "pregnant" or "required".

modes.label: Contraception method phrase
modes.description: The word contraception after phrases like "method of" or "effective" in advice to use backup or alternative birth control.
modes.example: Counsel women to use an alternative method of<< contraception>> or a backup method when enzyme inducers

modes.label: Barrier methods added
modes.description: Verbs or nouns that finish an instruction to add barrier contraceptive methods.
modes.example: Additional barrier contraceptive methods must be<< used>>.

modes.label: Avoid pregnancy or adjust dose
modes.description: Closing words of a related instruction, such as avoiding pregnancy or a lower insulin dose being needed.
modes.example: Women of child-bearing potential should be advised to avoid becoming<< pregnant>>.

card.writes: It seems to suppress the word "before" after such advice, so the sentence is less likely to continue with timing like "before starting".
card.plain: It marks the end of advice to use extra or alternative birth control while on a drug.
